<<Notes on Mending Of Fishing Nets>>  
Fishing nets are essential for the livelihood of many communities, but they often become damaged during fishing. To ensure sustainability, local groups are organizing regular mending sessions. These events not only repair nets but also promote community cooperation and resource sharing. Participants learn basic net care techniques and gain a sense of collective responsibility. By repairing nets, communities reduce waste and extend their lifespan, supporting both economic and environmental health. Join us in preserving our fishing resources and strengthening our community bonds.
